meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: Claude 会把仓库的 issue 积压按根本原因而不是表面现象分组,为每组创建 plan-master issue 和 plans/ 设计文档,用固定评论关闭所有子 issue,并生成带 Closes #N 的 PR 一次关闭整组。新来的 bug 会被归入已有 master 追加评论,不新开 issue。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20+ 个开放 issue 且很多疑似同根因,或你要求做归类/去重/制定计划等,或想判断新 bug 是否属于现有工作时触发。
howto.what_en: Clusters issues by root cause, creates a master issue + plans doc per cluster, closes children via a standard redirect, and ships a PR closing all children atomically. New bugs are appended as Round-N comments to a matching master.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo has 20+ open issues that look like shared root causes, when asked to triage, consolidate, or plan the issue list, or when a new bug needs routing to existing work.

say_en.text: Cluster by root cause, open masters, close children with the standard redirect.
say_en.note: Claude runs the initial clustering pass.

say_en.text: Is this new bug related to plan-02? Please fold it into that master.
say_en.note: Claude triages, adds a Round-N comment, then closes.

say_en.text: For plan-01, build a PR with Closes #N per child and add the test matrix to CI.
say_en.note: Claude bundles the cluster into one PR.
